title: Singapore Getaway | FREE Night Safari Zoo Visit
highlights: Discover Singapore’s unique fusion of historic charm and cutting-edge innovation, reflected in its skyline and culturally rich neighborhoods.
Experience the Night Safari Zoo, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park, observing 2,500+ animals in natural habitats under moonlight.
Capture iconic photos with the Merlion Statue, Singapore’s symbol of prosperity, against Marina Bay’s stunning backdrop.
Discover Esplanade, Singapore’s premier arts center, and enjoy world-class performances under its unique durian-shaped roof.
Visit Madame Tussauds, where you can find detailed and lifelike wax figures of celebrities, sports stars, and historical icons.
overview:
About the Tour:
Famed as the “Lion City”, this cosmopolitan town deserves a spot on your ultimate bucket list. From being just a commercial hub to one of the most visited countries in Asia, this tiny, yet easy explore-destination is one of those Asian potpourris of cultures that will leave you entranced. 
Apart from having the natural advantage of being a port city, Singapore also houses some exceptional manmade landscapes that will leave you spellbound. The incredible shopping malls, extravagant food, picture-perfect skyline, classy boutiques, departmental stores on Orchard Road, the exotic elements of Chinatown and Little India, and the world-class nightlife span across the spotless land of Singapore, giving you a number of chances to create fun memories for a lifetime.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
Flights are subjective to availablity. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a different flight.
Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.

Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Visit Night Safari Zoo
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. Afterward, board your transfer to the Night Safari Zoo, the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Explore its seven distinct zones and observe animals as they roam in their natural nighttime environments. Experience the Creatures of the Night show, where you’ll see animals like the Asian Lion and Tasmanian Devil Elephants in action. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Tour to Singapore | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Singapore. Start at the iconic Merlion Statue, symbolizing the city’s maritime heritage. Next, visit the Esplanade, a renowned performing arts center with unique architecture. Pass through the Civic District, admiring landmarks like the CBD area and cultural Chinatown. Afterward, you'll be transferred to your hotel. You can explore attractions like the Singapore Zoo and Gardens by the Bay at your own pace. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Cable Car Ride | Visit Madame Tussauds
days.desc: Today, embark on a thrilling sky-high adventure with the Singapore Cable Car. You will be transferred to Mount Faber Station. Enjoy panoramic views of Mount Faber Park, Harbourfront, and the cityscape. Continue your journey to Sentosa Island to explore its attractions. Next, head to Siloso Point station and visit Madame Tussauds Singapore, featuring lifelike wax figures of global icons. Later, you'll be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
